prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ createRecipeBook }`.

`createRecipeBook(initialRecipes)` creates an in-memory recipe collection. A recipe is `{ id, title, ingredients }`, where `id` and `title` are non-empty strings after trimming and `ingredients` is an array of non-empty strings after trimming. Store all three in trimmed form. Additional fields are ignored.

`initialRecipes` must be an array and duplicate trimmed IDs throw `RangeError`. Invalid shapes or field types throw `TypeError`. The returned object must expose exactly these methods:
- `add(recipe)`: validate and add a new recipe; duplicate ID throws `RangeError`; return a detached recipe copy.
- `get(id)`: use the trimmed non-empty string ID; return a detached copy or `null`.
- `update(id, changes)`: `changes` must be a non-null non-array object and may contain `title` and/or `ingredients`, but not `id`; omitted fields remain unchanged. Validate all supplied fields before changing stored data. Return a detached updated copy, or `null` for an unknown ID.
- `remove(id)`: delete a recipe and return whether it existed.
- `list()`: return detached copies in insertion order. Updating does not change order.

An empty ingredient array is valid. No returned recipe or ingredient array may alias internal state or caller-owned data. Failed operations must leave state unchanged.

Provide one complete source file using `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
